name: Designated Antagonist [Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
When you antagonize your foes, you can redirect their enmity to your ally.

Prerequisite(s): Antagonize.

Benefit(s): When you succeed at a skill check using Antagonize, you can cause the target creature to focus its efforts on a willing ally, as if the ally had been the one to use the ability.
